messages.author: deb55ea526b6a46e
parts:
Hello ggplot community,
Recently a poster on SO asked about facet_wrap: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/10183292/how-can-i-remove-empty-factors-from-ggplot2-facets/10183359#10183359
They wanted to drop a factor and cut out extra unused space in each plot.  We got the drop a factor with drop=TRUE but the getting rid of unused space didn't work with space = "free" (usually work with facet_grid and thought that wrap and grid take essentially the same arguments).  Is there a space="free" type argument for facet_wrap?
#EXAMPLE CODE

ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg, wt, colour = factor(cyl)))  +

    geom_point()  +

    facet_wrap(~ cyl, ncol=1, scales = "free_x") 

Tyler Rinker

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re:
parts:
Hi:

See ?facet_wrap. facet_grid() has a space = 'free' argument, but not
facet_wrap(). In 0.9.0, facet_grid() also has a space = 'free_x' and
'free_y' option, so you might want to try it out on your example.

Dennis
